entry_door: INTENT — design direction from Akien: the division is system device (host) and cairn device (hardware layer infrastructure)
intention: The cairn device absorbs the foundational infrastructure — ground_loop, bus, harbor_master — as held machines rather than independent devices. The division is: system device (host itself) and cairn device (cairn hardware layer), and everything else builds extensions to that functionality.
why: ground_loop, bus, and harbor_master share the cairn process tree today, have no independent shim logic beyond the base, and exist to serve other devices — machine smell, not device smell. Making them held machines is the honest version of what they already are: infrastructure composed by the thing they serve. Same code, fewer devices, simpler roster. Akien (2026-08-28): 'we're reorging to that is now the encapsulating container, and that kind of shuffle simplifies.'
traces_to: Law 6 — everything has exactly one owner; the foundational components currently have no coherent owner as a group; the cairn device becomes that owner
Complexity axis (CLAUDE.md) — a machine is tools plus glue, composed by devices; ground_loop/bus/rack are glue, not independent top-level things
watchme: none, because the falsifier is checkable in one proof session — the three directories to migrate are at cairn/devices/ground_loop/, cairn/devices/bus/, cairn/devices/harbor_master/ today, and the intention to amend is CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-the-cairn-device.md. The proof is: directories moved, proofs pass at new addresses, charter amended. No ongoing watch needed beyond the proof gate.
falsifier: DONE when the cairn device charter (I-the-cairn-device.md) names ground_loop, bus, and harbor_master as held machines, their code addresses move from devices/<name>/ to devices/cairn/machines/<name>/, and the exclusion list is amended. WRONG INTENT if any of the three genuinely needs device independence — if it has an independent purpose beyond infrastructure, or if the process ladder requires it in a separate process from the cairn device for isolation reasons.
horizon: the build lands — cairn device charter amended, directories moved, proofs pass at new addresses, roster reflects the topology

gates.proof_gate: tester — the three components still pass their existing proofs at their new addresses, the cairn device's charter names them as held machines, and the roster reflects the new topology

how: Reclassify ground_loop, bus, and harbor_master from devices to machines held by the cairn device at devices/cairn/machines/. Their shims become internal composition. Amend I-the-cairn-device.md to remove the three from the 'does NOT own' exclusion list and add them as held machines. Instance-space follows the same pattern at ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/machines/. The cairn device directory (devices/cairn/) must exist first.
